content:
elaine (AE): FYI kicking off a short presales thread for ACME Health POC. They want PHI controls but are open to validating prompt sets on Hosted first. Need to align scope, success criteria, hosting choice, and ballpark pricing. Who can help weigh in?

mateo (SE): I can. Quick Q: are they doing real PHI in the POC or synthetic? That changes the timeline for Private/VPC.

kevin (ACME): we'll start with de-identified sample data for evals, but the goal is real PHI in production. POC must show routing + fallbacks and perf on 8k prompts.

jaya (Solutions): Perfect. Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
- Week 0: onboarding, credentials, brief security review
- Week 1: run prompt/eval set (8k items), measure accuracy & throughput
- Week 2: sanity checks, rollback/fallback test, handoff doc + cost estimate

elaine (AE): Success criteria we suggested to them:
- Functional: 90%+ pass rate on the eval prompts (business rules match)
- Perf: p95 latency < 300ms for typical queries, sustained throughput 30 qps
- Reliability: automatic fallback to smaller model on errors, no data leakage observed
- Security: SOC2 controls acknowledged + encryption at rest in the target mode

sec-team: If they plan to move to PHI later, Private (VPC or on-prem) will be required for our compliance checklist. Hosted can be used for prompt tuning only with strict data handling (de-id or ephemeral). We need them to sign the DPA addendum before any sample PHI.

mateo (SE): Deployment tradeoffs (short):
- Hosted: fastest spin-up, lowest friction. Good for evals and prompt tuning. Limited for PHI unless customers accept de-id + DPA.
- Dedicated: reserved capacity, stronger isolation, predictable latency. Can be in customer-region, supports higher SLAs.
- Private: customer-managed VPC or on-prem, full residency and KMS/HSM control. Longest lead time (2-6 weeks depending on infra).

kevin (ACME): they'd prefer Dedicated if it means we can guarantee residency in us-east-1 and stronger SLAs. How different is the pricing vs Hosted?

jaya (Solutions): Ballpark numbers (for presales conv only):
- Hosted: usage-based, approx $X per 1M tokens (we usually give credits for POC)
- Dedicated: monthly reserved pool + overage. For small POC: minimal monthly commit ~ $6k-$15k depending on GPU mix.
- Private: license + deployment costs; usually a few months of commit equivalent up front + onboarding.
(We'll send a tailored quote after we know model size and qps.)

elaine (AE): Action item: I told Kevin we'd propose two flows: 1) quick Hosted POC on de-identified data (2 weeks) to validate prompts and metrics, 2) parallel Dedicated evaluation (short-lived dedicated node in us-east-1) to validate SLA and residency. Agree?

sec-team: Agree to the two-track approach provided ACME signs the DPA. We'll need to run a short security questionnaire (SSQ) and confirm KMS requirements if they go Dedicated/Private.

mateo (SE): For the evals, please send the prompt set in CSV format. We'll run against 3 candidate model variants and return a result matrix. Sample run command (internal):

```bash
redwood eval run --prompts sample_eval.csv --models r-instruct-13b,r-2b-quant --region us-east-1 --out results.json
```

sam-infra-bot: scheduled: dedicated test node provisioning window available Tue/Wed next week in us-east-1. ETA 4 hours once started.

jaya (Solutions): Timeline proposal in milestones:
- Day 0: sign DPA + share eval prompt CSV and success criteria
- Day 1-2: Hosted quick-run (sanity) + baseline metrics
- Day 3-7: Dedicated short node runs (throughput & failover tests)
- Day 8-10: Security review, logs access check, KMS test if needed
- Day 11-14: Final report + pricing + recommended production mode

kevin (ACME): sounds good. we'll get the eval CSV and DPA over by EOD tomorrow. Any blockers on our side?

elaine (AE): none from sales. I'll prep an intro pack (DPA link, minimal SSQ) and loop in legal.

mateo (SE): One more thing on success metrics: please include a small set of red-team prompts to test hallucination and PII leakage — we will instrument checks and include in the pass criteria.

sec-team: Also confirm logging retention window and whether they need redact-on-ingest. We'll capture that in the SSQ.

jaya (Solutions): I'll draft a short POC runbook and attach quick how-tos for switching routing policy between Hosted/Dedicated and enabling KV cache. Example snippet to switch routing in config:

```json
{"routing": {"policy": "prefer_dedicated", "fallback": "hosted"}}
```

elaine (AE): Thanks all — I'll create the official POC thread and send calendar invites after we get the CSV + DPA. If we hit any roadblocks (quota, region availability), call out here and @sam-infra-bot will help. :thumbsup:
